title: Retail SMS Marketing: How to Reach and Engage Shoppers | Vibes

facts.fact: Per a McKinsey survey cited by Vibes, nearly half of consumers still cite inflation as a major concern in 2024.
facts.quote: nearly half of consumers still cite inflation as a major concern in 2024

facts.fact: Vibes states that 77% of consumers are actively using 'trading down' (buying less-expensive alternatives) to save money, in the context of the McKinsey survey.
facts.quote: is a strategy that 77% are actively using to save money

facts.fact: Vibes cites Statista for the claim that SMS has a 98% open rate.
facts.quote: As reported by Statista, with a 98% open rate SMS bypasses cluttered inboxes

facts.fact: Vibes states that a standard text message has a requirement of no more than 160 characters.
facts.quote: with a standard text message’s requirement of no more than 160 characters
